install_aide:
Usage: installer-backend-<machine>.sh [options]
No question is asked: option, else environment variable, else default value (see the script header).
Common options: --aide, --version, --verifier (parameters and prerequisites, read-only), --alpha-test (checkpoints and log), --retour-arriere --jeu <name> --confirme, --activer, --sauter <step> (sudoers, nftables, isolation_remus, www-data, produit, fonctions), --jeu <name>, --depot, --langue, --dossier-journal, --code-remplacement-confirme, --session-secours, --stockage-actif, --mise-a-jour (updates an existing installation: versions compared, only the Paresia units are stopped then started again, modified configuration files are kept, automatic rollback if a check fails; incompatible with --retour-arriere and --verifier).
The script runs from a clone of the repository; it clones nothing (the machine is updated with --mise-a-jour).
install_echec: Stopped at step {etape} (exit code {code}). Read the previous message, fix the cause then rerun
install_err_acces_tunnel: Refused: the paresia_relais table is not loaded; the tunnel account is opened only for a test (--acces-tunnel-sans-nftables oui)

Find the matching product at {source}, or make the image tag match this version (a tag without a version, such as latest, is a mismatch), then run the script again
install_err_produit_declaration: Refused: the product declaration of the shipped functions is missing, unreadable or inconsistent; nothing was modified
install_err_depot: Invalid repository: physical absolute path, no symbolic link, with the server/ and i18n/ folders
install_err_difference: Refused: the state of {element} differs from the expected one; nothing was changed (--code-remplacement-confirme oui allows replacement, --mise-a-jour updates an existing installation)
install_err_empreinte: Refused: fingerprint mismatch, expected {attendu}, found {releve}; nothing was installed
install_err_essai_tcp: Local TCP test invalid: fix and retry; the unit is not enabled

install_err_journal_existe: The log {chemin} already exists; it is never overwritten

install_err_retour_sans_sauvegarde: Backups are disabled: rollback is impossible
install_err_root_interdit: This script refuses to run as root: run it under an ordinary account with sudo

install_err_sauvegarde: Backup set failed: check the disk space and the permissions of /var/backups/paresia, then rerun; do not continue

install_err_sshd_t: sshd -t failed: the installed file was restored, sshd is not reloaded
